label: Cash spent on buildings, equipment & other assets
scope: Amazon-wide cash capital expenditure. Mainly technology infrastructure supporting AWS and capacity for its delivery network. This is not an AI-only spending figure or Jeff Bezos’s wealth.
overlapNotes: Do not add company spending to investor funding, supplier revenues, or shared project announcements.
context: AI needs real buildings, servers, and chips. Amazon’s spending also pays for its broader cloud and delivery businesses.
contextTitle: The cloud has a very large ground floor.

label: Raised from investors in the Series E round
scope: One xAI financing round, announced before its acquisition by SpaceX. It is not annual spending, consolidated SpaceX expenditure, or Elon Musk’s wealth.
overlapNotes: Funding may later pay suppliers. Counting both can count the same money twice.
context: Investors provide capital to a company. The amount raised does not tell us how much it has already spent on buildings or chips.
contextTitle: The tide came in. With investors.

label: Committed capital in a closed funding round
scope: OpenAI’s announced committed capital in this funding round. A commitment is not evidence that every dollar has been received or spent. This is not Sam Altman’s wealth.
sourceTitle: OpenAI: Accelerating the next phase of AI
overlapNotes: Amazon, NVIDIA, and SoftBank participated. Do not add this round to the same investors’ announcements as separate money.
context: Amazon, NVIDIA, and SoftBank anchored this round. Some of the companies funding the AI wave also supply the cloud and chips beneath it.
contextTitle: Some of the surfers also sell the boards.

label: Estimated personal net worth
scope: Forbes annual billionaire snapshot. Assets less debts; not cash in the bank. Market prices change and private holdings are estimates.
overlapNotes: A personal wealth stock, separate from company spending or funding.
context: Wealth is an estimate of assets less debts, often held in company shares. It is not a pile of spendable cash.
contextTitle: A fortune. Not a bank balance.
